body.q: Who became the new CEO of Centific in August 2026?

results.name: Centific Announces Leadership Transition: Chuen Hong Lew to Succeed Venkat Rangapuram as Chief Executive Officer | Centific
results.content:
#### Former Granite Asia Partner to Lead Centific's Next Phase of Growth as a Global Data and AI Solutions Provider.  
Centific, a leading global data and AI solutions company, today announced that Chuen Hong Lew will become Chief Executive Officer, effective August 3, 2026, succeeding Venkat Rangapuram, who has led the company through a period of significant growth and global expansion.  
Chuen Hong joins Centific from Granite Asia, where he served as a Partner, leading the firm's partnerships ecosystem and special strategic projects. This gave him broad visibility into the AI ecosystem and the dynamics shaping the sector.  
“Chuen Hong is well positioned to lead Centific as we accelerate our ambition to become a leading global data and AI solutions company,” said Tiak Koon Loh, Chairman of the Board of Centific. “The Board is grateful to Venkat and the management team for the strong foundation they have built and is confident that Chuen Hong will carry this momentum into Centific’s next phase of growth.”  
Chuen Hong previously served as Chief Executive of Singapore's Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA), shaping digital technology strategy and AI adoption at a national level. He is a Fellow at Stanford's Institute for Human-Centered AI (HAI) and also serves on the International Council for Responsible AI UK.
Chuen Hong’s experience leading national initiatives in frontier technologies, digital infrastructure and AI adoption, together with his work in international collaboration, aligns closely with Centific’s focus on enabling the trusted and resilient scaling and deployment of AI globally.  
“Centific sits at the center of something that genuinely matters: making AI systems work in a trusted, resilient way by engineering the data that reflects the world's knowledge,” said Chuen Hong. “I'm honored to build on the foundation Venkat and the team have created, and I look forward to working closely with our people, our partners and our customers as we take Centific into its next chapter of growth.”  
“Leading Centific through this stage of the AI industry has been the privilege of my career, but the credit belongs to our management team and everyone across this company; they're the ones who built this,” said Venkat. “I'm proud of what we've accomplished together, and I have complete confidence that Chuen Hong is the right leader to take Centific into its next chapter. I'm not going far: I will remain on the Board and work closely with Chuen Hong to support a smooth transition.”
## About Centific  
Centific (www.centific.com) is a global data and AI solutions company backed by Granite Asia, serving leading AI labs and global enterprises with the human expertise, data infrastructure, and evaluation environments needed to build trusted, resilient AI systems. With more than 3,000 employees and a global expert network of over 2 million contributors spanning 230+ markets through its OneForma platform, Centific partners with organizations at the frontier of AI development.

results.name: Pactera EDGE announces strategic rebrand as Centific | MultiLingual
results.content:
REDMOND, Wash. /PRNewswire/ — Pactera EDGE, a world-class digital solutions provider for the data-driven, intelligent enterprise, announced today that it has rebranded as Centific. The rebranding, which includes a new name, logo, and visual identity system, takes effect immediately.  
The rebranding as Centific comes three years after Pactera EDGE spun off from its parent company, Pactera Technology International Ltd., back in 2020. Since then, the company has chartered its own path, doubling down on its Data, Intelligence, and Global Experiences capabilities, investing in fresh new talent and market-leading intelligence solutions, and refining its processes to provide clients with greater efficiencies, all with a human-centric philosophy.  
“Our new brand, Centific, is the culmination of the many milestones we have achieved over the past three years and reflects the evolution we’ve undergone as a leading digital solutions provider for our clients,” said Venkat Rangapuram, CEO of Centific. “It represents who we’ve become and, more importantly, where we’re going.”  
The word “Centific” (pronounced cen-ti’-fik) is inspired by the human-centric approach to the company’s solutions, coupled with the rigor characterized in its execution. The rebranding does not change the company’s legal structure or shareholder composition.
“As our clients seek even greater flexibility in their vendor engagement models, our next frontier is the expansion of our AI-infused cloud-based software platform that will match our clients’ bespoke project needs with the right resources,” said Rangapuram. “The Centific platform will leverage both the experience of our full-time employees and the know-how of a carefully curated gig workforce.”  
“This new identity reflects not only our mission and values but also the vibrant energy that you can feel inside the company,” said Rangapuram. ” At Centific, we believe in the symbiotic relationship among humans, businesses, and technology. Our single-minded goal is to harness the power of technology to enhance business value and the human experience. We look forward to continuing to do so, now as Centific.”  
Centific works with top Fortune 500 clients with an array of customer experience, data, intelligence, and IT services, delivering award-winning solutions on an enterprise scale.  
To learn more about Centific and its services, visit:[https://www.centific.com](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=3763063-1&h=4127135209&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.centific.com%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.centific.com)  
For media inquiries, contact:[lynn@maracaibomedia.com](https://multilingual.com/pactera-edge-announces-strategic-rebrand-as-centific/mailto:lynn@maracaibomedia.com)
